lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior of the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to low luminance on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-intensity silhouettes corresponding to commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral side and near the pectoral fin.
